evidence: All 18 routes are in Box Canyon itself (MP area 106080663, side canyon north of the Maple Canyon road, about 0.8 mi up). No source names a wall or sub-place inside it and no sibling rock wall hosts ice; no placeable name found.
Four ice routes in the Middle Fork of Maple Canyon; no source found placing them on a sibling wall or naming a sub-place. Left in the leaf.

Hidden Haven (MP 106093282) is ice at the head of a side drainage about 5.9 mi up Parowan Canyon; the only place name is the route's own name, and sibling Perch at Hidden Haven is a rock crag, so not moved.
Single route about 2 mi up Mineral Fork, east side, near the Kessler West Couloir descent (MP 107008103); no named crag, and the route name equals the leaf name so cannot be used.
Jedediah not found by search; no source places it. Siblings Love Canal and Clitoweris are rock crags with no ice evidence.

Angel's Tiers (north side, quarry area) and Providence Falls (south side, quarry area) per MP 109990818; no named crag or sibling holds them, and they are on opposite sides so no single sourced place name.
MP 106458405 says routes are mostly in avalanche gullies on the south side of the canyon; no named gully, wall or mile marker for these routes, and none sit on the rock-wall siblings.

MP Cedar Canyon (106090574) says climbs are off Hwy 14 about mile markers 8-12, plus a Sand cuts area and Ashdown Gorge; no location given for Cedarcicle, Carmel Cubes, Suicide Flows or Sunday Morning. Ashdown Gorge sibling is a parent (5 subareas) and cannot hold routes; no sourced place name, so kept.
